candle-5-tax.title: ROSE SANTAL 240g
candle-5-tax.body_html:
Rose Santal / Pure Soy - Like the hue of Noor Jahan, is set in 2023. Delicate, graceful and blooming from the 10th century red rose. Dancing in all the Santal glory this blend is a form of interdependency of Rose with Sandalwood. The power play of the two, light and dark Ingredients, brought together in this unique structure is immaculate. This blend could classify as an all day, only night or an only day blend. perfume.title: PURO ROYALE
perfume.body_html:
Step into the festive season draped in opulence with Pure Royale, a masterful unisex blend from NASO that redefines luxury. Crafted for those who command presence without uttering a word, this fragrance is a bold and sophisticated symphony of depth and elegance.
Opening with a radiant burst of grapefruit and mandarin, Pure Royale invites you in with a citrusy freshness that feels vibrant and celebratory. As the scent evolves, leather and Oudh unveil a rich, smoky sensuality, perfectly balanced by the grounding earthiness of vetiver and the alluring warmth of musk. Finally, patchouli lingers softly, tying the composition together with a touch of timeless mystique.
Each note is thoughtfully layered to create a scent that’s both unapologetically luxurious and strikingly versatile—unisex by design, and magnetic by nature. Whether you're at a festive soirée or an intimate gathering, Pure Royale makes a statement: bold yet refined, familiar yet unforgettable.
Turn heads. Leave a trail. Be Royale.

Top Note: Sweet Mahogany and Cardamom

Heart Note: Petrichor and jasmine 

Base Note: Patchouli and Oudh

perfume.title: PURO LUSSO
perfume.body_html:
PURO LUSSO, meaning "Pure Luxury" in Italian, is a fragrance that exudes
unparalleled sophistication. This scent is a tribute to the depth and warmth of Middle
Eastern traditions, reimagined with a contemporary flair.


• Fragrance Profile:
Top Notes: A captivating burst of clove and cumin sets a rich and spicy tone,
creating an inviting warmth.


Heart Notes: At its core lies an ethereal bloom of rose, lending a delicate yet
regal character to the composition.


Base Notes: The dry-down reveals the smoky allure of oud and the rich, resinous
depth of bukhoor, evoking the grandeur of Arabian nights.


PURO LUSSO is for those who appreciate the finer things in life—a scent that envelops
the wearer in a veil of timeless luxury and confidence.

HEALING PROPERTIES :

  • Unnerves Stressed Mind
  • Elevates Sate Of Being
  • Enhances Confidence

perfume.title: PURO DIVINI
perfume.body_html:
PURO DIVINI, translating to "Pure Divine," captures the essence of transcendence. It is
a poetic composition that seamlessly blends floral elegance with woody intensity,
making it a fragrance of profound contrasts.
• Fragrance Profile:
Top Notes: The intoxicating charm of Raat Ki Raani (night-blooming jasmine)
introduces the scent with a sultry, nocturnal allure.


Heart Notes: The soft, velvety richness of rose adds a delicate sweetness,
creating a perfect floral harmony.


Base Notes: The fragrance culminates in a grounded base of cedarwood and the
smoky sensuality of oud, leaving an unforgettable trail of sophistication.


PURO DIVINI is for the modern connoisseur who seeks a fragrance that is both
evocative and enduring—a true celebration of divine beauty and grace.

perfume.title: ROSE SANTAL
perfume.body_html:
Like the hue of Noor Jahan, is set in 2023. Delicate, graceful and blooming from the 10th century red rose. Dancing in all the Santal glory this blend is a form of interdependency of Rose with Sandalwood. The power play of the two, light and dark Ingridients, brought together in this unique structure is immaculate. This blend could classify as an all day, only night or an only day blend. This variety of rose brings the bloom in this fragrance balancing the act with the seductive sandalwood. The sound nature of Santal grounds this blend. The importance of Lucknavi Gulab, Ruh Gulab is considered as the worlds’ most important flower in perfumery today. Rose Santal brings forward the perfect play of light & dark, or some may say masculine and feminine  nature of ingredients to light. The Gender - Neutral blend, as a masculine energy while a dim bloom of the feminine rose.

Khus Noir explores the softer, more sophisticated character of khus, transforming its earthy essence into a refined olfactory experience. The result is a fragrance that is elegant, understated, and deeply evocative.

Created for the discerning individual, Khus Noir is an ode to quiet luxury. eau-de-parfum.title: KHUS NOIR
eau-de-parfum.body_html:
Khus, an ancient Indian botanical, has been cherished for generations for its naturally cooling properties and its ability to restore balance to the body. At Naso, we have rediscovered this timeless ingredient through our research and reimagined it with a distinctly modern sensibility.

Khus Noir explores the softer, more sophisticated character of khus, transforming its earthy essence into a refined olfactory experience. The result is a fragrance that is elegant, understated, and deeply evocative.

Created for the discerning individual, Khus Noir is an ode to quiet luxury. It is for those who seek refinement over excess, who value craftsmanship over convention, and whose appreciation for beauty is intimate rather than ostentatious. A fragrance that doesn’t demand attention—it earns it through character, depth, and effortless sophistication.

  • Cools the body temperature

How to use: Keep the wicks trimmed. This will give you a nice bright flame. Wicks should be one-fourth inch high this ensures an even and smooth flames. Always light to wicks the candle will burn more evenly and youll use the wax more efficiently. Dip your finger tip in the soy oil whilst it burns.Use the pure soy oil on the back of your wrist, inside of your elbow or side of your neck to improve your sleep quality, to calm your anxiety and boost energy.

Shelf life: 24 months

Care instructions: Keep away from children. Keep away from mouth and nose

All products are non – returnable and non-exchangeable. Returns / replacement will be only accepted for fulfilment errors such as incorrectly shipped or missing items Damages due to neglect, improper usage or application will not be covered under our returns policy.
